name: Shapefiles of BOA and Community Brownfield Planning Areas - OER Existing Conditions Studies
description:
This dataset contains polygon shapefiles for nine Brownfield Opportunity Area (BOA) and community brownfield planning areas studied under New York State's Existing Conditions Studies program, administered by the NYC Office of Environmental Remediation. Each record represents one planning area and includes a unique ID, the area's name (such as Red Hook, Harlem Gateway, or Edgemere Arverne), the community organization associated with the area, a link to the project's EPIC page, a link to the Existing Conditions Study document, and the polygon's area in square units. A contacts field is present but empty for all rows.

The data is a small reference layer suited to mapping and spatial analysis. It can be used to locate and visualize brownfield planning areas, connect each area to its sponsoring community organization and project documentation, and join the polygons with other geographic layers for land-use, environmental review, or redevelopment planning. Because the dataset is limited to nine areas and lacks contact details, it is best treated
